name: TruDefinition
address: 1526 Fort Worth Ave Unit 2205, Dallas, TX 75208, USA

reviews.name: Bryan H.
reviews.text: First off, I would like to again thank Tommy and his team for all the phenomenal work they did to complete our home automation system.   Not only were they on budget, they provided service and technical expertise that was well above anything I have experienced in my last two home automation installs.   The attention to detail they displayed in customizing my system to meet my specs blew me away.    The quality of the final product they delivered was over and above my expectations of what I thought I would receive for the money spent.  The team was nothing but friendly and professional throughout install.  They are a real pleasure to work with.   I cannot recommend enough Tru Definition for your Home Automation project.

reviews.name: Dawn K.
reviews.text: The professionals at Tru Definition are truly some of the cleanest, quietest, most knowledgeable contractors I dealt with during building. We have over 14tvs, music, lighting on numerous snetworks they have not only installed but tied them in for voice commamd and manual They provide great customer service after they finish up. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Brett C.
reviews.text: This is not the first time I have used TruDefinition and it will definitely not be the last! I have been using their services for years now, they have always gone above and beyond on my automation needs.Be it savant products or helping me setup a beautiful turntable system. They even went above and beyond when I was having issues with my out of date savant universal remote, they did all the heavy lifting for me and got it replaced. I highly recommend them for any and all of your home automation needs.

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: I found TruDefinition a few years back, and use their services exclusively. Tommy and team are VERY knowledgeable, and happy to give up time to explain and educate. I’ve used other companies in the past, big box stores like best buy magnolia, and smaller companies as well. None of them come close to the professional and courteous services offered by Tru. Above that, their prices are reasonable and they don’t clock abuse on service/installation calls.

reviews.name: Matt D.
reviews.text: We (CinemaTech) worked with Tommy and his team to deliver a luxury home theater for a client in Colleyville last year and the experience was great from start to finish.  Tommy and his team were great communicators and provided an incredible AV package that blew the client away.  We look forward to our next project with TruDefinition and recommend them to anyone looking for an outstanding home experience.
